topics.title: Two-Line Element (TLE) Sets & SGP4 Orbital Propagation
topics.objective: Predict satellite trajectories and positions in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) using Simplified General Perturbations (SGP4).
topics.exercise: Propagate an active satellite orbit 72 hours forward and output state vectors in Earth-Centered Inertial (ECI) frame.

topics.title: Conjunction Data Messages (CDM) & Miss Distance Analysis
topics.objective: Parse Space Surveillance Network CDMs and compute closest approach geometry and radial separation.
topics.example: MissDistance = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2); TCA = TimeOfClosestApproach;
topics.exercise: Write a parser extracting miss distance, relative velocity, and covariance matrices from NASA/Space-Track CDMs.

topics.title: Collision Probability Estimation (Foster-1992 Algorithm)
topics.objective: Integrate 2D encounter plane error covariances to compute the Probability of Collision (Pc).
topics.example: Pc = (1 / (2 * pi * sigma_x * sigma_y)) * exp(-0.5 * (x^2 / sigma_x^2 + y^2 / sigma_y^2)) * Area
topics.exercise: Implement a numerical integration routine computing collision probability for a 5-meter combined hard-body radius.

topics.title: Delta-V Collision Avoidance Maneuver Planning
topics.objective: Calculate optimal thrust impulses that maximize radial/in-track separation while conserving onboard propellant.
topics.exercise: Compute an in-track burn vector 1 orbit prior to TCA reducing collision probability below 1e-7 with minimal delta-v.

topics.title: Post-Mission Disposal & 5-Year Deorbit Regulatory Compliance
topics.objective: Plan controlled atmospheric re-entry or disposal graveyard orbits adhering to FCC and IADC guidelines.
topics.example: PerigeeAltitude < 150km for atmospheric drag decay within 5 years.
topics.exercise: Simulate orbital lifetime decay from 550km under varying solar flux and atmospheric drag coefficients.
